## Load Packages

```{r}
setwd("~/R Studio/NSAS Herring/NSAS-Herring")

library(bcp)
library(changepoint)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(FSA)
library(strucchange)
library(MASS)
library(hydroGOF)
library(mgcv)
library(INDperform)
```

## Import data

```{r}
load("data/Herring_full.Rdata")

### Load plotting function from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
results_cpt <- changepoint_analysis(Herring_full, 
                                          region_name = "Full Stock",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.5,
                                          ssb_col = "SSB")
# CPT changepoint indices:  4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72 
# CPT changepoint years:    1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  20,   37,   54 
# BCP changepoint years:    1966, 1983, 2000 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1966, 2000 
# CPT only: 1950, 1964, 1986, 2018 
# BCP only: 1983 
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Call "breakpoint_analysis" function
results_brkpt <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "F", "year",
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Full Stock")

# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.25  1.43  0.43  0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1960, 1971, 1986, 2000 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, results_brkpt$break_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

models_SRR <- run_srr_analysis(
    data_for_srr = Herring_full[-(79:78),],
   recruit_col = "R",
   ssb_col = "SSB",
   opt_brks_val = 4)

print(models_SRR$comparison_table)

#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE

# Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis
results_SRR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "R", "year", "Herring Full")

# Optimal number of breaks: 2 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 264793.8  2391903.7 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1981,     2002 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, break_years = results_SRR$break_years, "Full Stock", "strucchange")
plot_SRR_full
```

#### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SRR_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# tGAM

```{r}
# Load env data
load("data/env_df_full.Rdata")

### Merge env data to fish
tGAM_data <- merge(Herring_full, env_df_full,by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)

### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 10.87623
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # FALSE, 8.561897
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 34.42214

#### No significant threshold effect found
```
